name: hostwatch
description: Inspect and manage Hostwatch infrastructure through its OAuth-protected MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Monitor and operate your servers with Hostwatch.
interface.longDescription: Connect to your Hostwatch organization with OAuth, using a signed-in iPhone QR code or email, password and two-factor verification. Inspect sites, errors, traffic, runtimes and TLS certificates; owner-approved actions require explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Check the health of my Hostwatch sites.
Investigate recent HTTP errors and suspicious traffic.
